what_these_are: ClinicalTrials.gov study records including posted results, one file per registration, retrieved from the registry API.
how_to_check_a_cell: The solicited injection-site outcome is a MULTI-CATEGORY measure. Naming the outcome does not identify a cell. Navigate to the outcome by its exact title, then to the named category inside classes[].categories[], then read the measurements row whose groupId matches the arm. The object stores a percentage; its event count is that percentage times the arm denominator, rounded.
